namespace RB {
  struct Layer {
    metal::texture2d<half> tex;
    float2 info[5];
    half4 sample(float2 p) const {
      p = metal::fma(p.x, info[0], metal::fma(p.y, info[1], info[2]));
      p = metal::clamp(p, info[3], info[4]);
      return tex.sample(metal::sampler(metal::filter::linear), p);
    }
  };
}
